Specification: This module defines helper operators for exporting TLC counterexample traces to JSON and replaying a previously dumped JSON trace. It serializes a counterexample, reconstructs the set of variable names appearing in the trace, detects the lasso target for liveness counterexamples by finding the unique back or stuttering edge in the action graph, and defines a replay constraint that checks the current TLC state against the stored trace level by level. It also defines a replay view that includes the current level to avoid state collapsing and maps the level beyond the finite dump back to the lasso target so liveness cycles can be replayed correctly. The design relies on JSON arrays to represent serialized sets and explicitly notes assumptions about ordering and variable-subset replay compatibility.
IfThenElse: IF CounterExample.state = {} \/ ("console" \in DOMAIN CounterExample /\ CounterExample["console"] = FALSE) THEN TRUE ELSE /\ LET trace == ToTrace(CounterExample) vars == UNION { DOMAIN trace[i] : i \in DOMAIN trace } IN JsonSerialize(_JsonTraceFile, [counterexample |-> CounterExample, vars |-> vars]) /\ PrintT("CounterExample written: " \o _JsonTraceFile) (in _JsonTrace)

IF \E i \in DOMAIN actions : actions[i][3][1] <= actions[i][1][1] THEN LET i == CHOOSE i \in DOMAIN actions : actions[i][3][1] <= actions[i][1][1] IN actions[i][3][1] ELSE 0 (in _JsonTraceLassoTarget)
IF level <= traceLen THEN << level, _TLCState(level) >> ELSE << lassoTarget, _TLCState(level) >> (in _JsonTraceView)
ChoiceExpr: CHOOSE i \in DOMAIN actions : actions[i][3][1] <= actions[i][1][1]
